rationale: Initial-hold refinement of two prior non-promoting near-miss entry sources. Very-short-horizon winners should show executable favorable reaction promptly; zero favorable excursion by a fixed early deadline is treated as causal entry invalidation, not mature-exit optimization.
rule: Protective stop remains first. Track maximum executable favorable excursion since entry using Bid-entry for long and entry-Ask for short. At the first tick at/after the reaction deadline, include that quote in max favorable excursion. If max favorable excursion <= 0 raw units, close immediately at the executable quote; otherwise continue the original frozen DELTA stop/trail/30-second lifecycle unchanged.
anti_overfit: Only 3/5/10-second deadlines are permitted. No favorable-excursion magnitude threshold, no session/side/weekday filter, and no new deadline after results. Any survivor must pass independent later-January validation unchanged.
